build_hmm_profile_from_stockholm: build an HMM profile from Stockholm format MSA using the Hmmbuild class with fast model construction
build_hmm_profile_from_a3m: build an HMM profile from A3M format MSA by stripping inserted residues and running hmmbuild
initialize_hmmbuild_wrapper: create an Hmmbuild wrapper instance with a binary path and optional singlemx flag for common substitution matrix
run_hmmbuild_subprocess: run the hmmbuild binary as a subprocess to generate HMM output from an amino acid MSA file
review_hmmbuild_class: review the Hmmbuild class and its methods for building HMM profiles from Stockholm or A3M MSA formats
